whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository of type `path`.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a repository of type `path`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm composer.json no longer carries a repository of type `path`.
